items.title: AI Accel,Tension-based pruning framework(40% sparsity, 1.5-2x speedups)
items.raw_excerpt: I built a PyTorch framework that achieves ~40% effective parameter reduction with 1.58x training and 2.05x inference speedups on mid-sized models—while keeping accuracy almost intact.Key ideas: Dynamic tension thresholds aggressively prune low-importance weights (with rollback for stability) Vibration-based deferral skips low-signal computations Entropy scheduling + sparse conversion for hardware gains It's a drop-in replacement for nn.Linear (CurvatureTuner) and works out-of-the-box on MLPs. Planning Transformer tests next.Benchmark on ~400k param MLP (synthetic data, 5 epochs): Baseline: Train 2.45s / Inf 0.0045s Enhanced: Eff params ~281k (40% reduction) / Train 1.55s (1.58x) / Inf 0.0022s (2.05x) Repo (MIT): https://github.com/wwes4/AI_Accel_1.5x Feedback, forks, and real-dataset tests

title_i18n.en: AI Accel,Tension-based pruning framework(40% sparsity, 1.5-2x speedups)
title_i18n.zh: AI加速器，基于张力的剪枝框架（稀疏度40%，速度提升1.5至2倍）
title_i18n.es: AI Accel, marco de poda basado en tensión (40% de esparsidad, aceleraciones de 1.5 a 2 veces)

excerpt_i18n.en: I built a PyTorch framework that achieves ~40% effective parameter reduction with 1.58x training and 2.05x inference speedups on mid-sized models—while keeping accuracy almost intact.Key ideas: Dynamic tension thresholds aggressively prune low-importance weights (with rollback for stability) Vibration-based deferral skips low-signal computations Entropy scheduling + sparse conversion for hardware gains It's a drop-in replacement for nn.Linear (CurvatureTuner) and works out-of-the-box on MLPs. Planning Transformer tests next.Benchmark on ~400k param MLP (synthetic data, 5 epochs): Baseline: Train 2.45s / Inf 0.0045s Enhanced: Eff params ~281k (40% reduction) / Train 1.55s (1.58x) / Inf 0.0022s (2.05x) Repo (MIT): https://github.com/wwes4/AI_Accel_1.5x Feedback, forks, and real-dataset tests
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我构建了一个PyTorch框架，在保持准确率基本不变的前提下，对中型模型实现了约40%的有效参数削减，训练速度提升1.58倍，推理速度提升2.05倍。核心思路：动态张力阈值。
excerpt_i18n.es: Desarrollé un framework en PyTorch que logra una reducción efectiva de parámetros de aproximadamente el 40%, con aceleraciones de entrenamiento de 1.58x y de inferencia de 2.05x en modelos de tamaño medio, manteniendo la precisión casi intacta. Ideas clave: Umbrales de tensión dinámicos.

items.title: Why do some people feel emotionally attached to AI models
items.raw_excerpt: This feels strange to admit. I notice that sometimes I speak to AI systems like they are a friend. I know they are not real. I know there is no person on the other side. Still my brain acts like there is. I feel a small emotional connection. I see comments online saying this happens to others too. I am trying to understand if this is a new psychological effect or if humans always did this with new technology. Maybe it is the same as talking to pets or giving names to cars. Or maybe it is something deeper. Why do you think this happens. Is it loneliness. Is it empathy misfiring. Is it design tricks. Is it harmless or dangerous. I am curious how the HN crowd sees it.

items.title: Is there an AI subscription plan comparison tool that's always updated?
items.raw_excerpt: I asked versions of this question to a few different models but I never found an accurate answer. I would like to compare the various free and paid AI subscription plans, primarily from the most popular vendors like ChatGPT, Claude, Google, etc. I can find countless static webpages, YouTube videos, etc. that compare subscriptions, but their information quickly becomes out-of-date, or isn't detailed enough. I'm looking for a tool that grabs the latest information on what each plan provides (features, models, context windows, etc.), and compares them across different subscriptions. I imagine this information would be obtained from API calls or scraping. The comparison tool should not rely on AI to get its information.. I want the latest facts (ideally checked at least once a day).

items.title: aiXcoder：AI并非软件开发的“银弹”，需与软件工程结合
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，硅心科技（aiXcoder）产品研发负责人黄宁受邀出席CSDN和奇点智能研究院联合主办的“全球C++及系统软件技术大会”，并发表《超越vibe coding，构建以人为主的可靠开发流程》主题演讲，与来自腾讯、阿里、百度等企业的领域专家共同探讨大模型驱动的软件开发现状及未来。 黄宁认为，Vibe Coding模式虽然在特定场景下展现出高效的生成能力，但却难以适配企业级复杂项目开发。AI并非软件开发的“银弹”，需要与软件工程相结合，构建集能力扩展与行为监测于一体的可靠AI研发流程，确保软件交付质量的可控、可预测与高效落地。   图：硅心科技（aiXcoder）产品研发负责人黄宁 企业级应用场景下，AI开发模式的挑战与思考 随着大模型能力提升，“通过自然语言指令让AI生成符合特定风格代码”的Vibe Coding开发模式日渐兴起，其核心特征是将代码细节几乎全部交由AI生成，人仅聚焦需求描述与最终结果。 然而，aiXcoder在工程实践和与企业的交流中发现，Vibe Coding模式直接应用于企业级项目会暴漏出诸多问题：AI生成的代码常忽略企业既有工具函数，擅自增加独立模块，追求“当下问题解决”而不顾后期维护，甚至因缺失安全校验留下漏洞隐患，增加代码评审负担。 深层原因在于，企业级复杂项目往往承载着长期的迭代需求，沉淀了大量隐性规则和多年维护的考量。而AI缺乏人类工程师的“吃亏经验”——无法预判未来需求变化、推演潜在风险，只能给出“局部最优解”，难以满足工程所需的“全局稳定性和未来可扩展性”要求。   图：Vibe Coding在企业级环境“水土不服”的原因分析 aiXcoder“AI+软件工程”实践路径 面对企业级智能化软件开发提效需求，aiXcoder秉承“围绕AI能力范围设计系统、确立开发者为项目最终责任主体、学习与传承软件知识”三大AI软件工程原则

title_i18n.zh: aiXcoder：AI并非软件开发的“银弹”，需与软件工程结合

excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Huang Ning, the product R&D lead at aiXcoder, was invited to speak at the "Global C++ and System Software Technology Conference" jointly organized by CSDN and Singularity Intelligent Research Institute. He delivered a keynote titled "Beyond Vibe Coding: Building Human-Centric, Reliable Development Processes," engaging with domain experts from companies like Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu to discuss the current state and future of large model-driven software development. Huang Ning argued that while the Vibe Coding model demonstrates efficient generation capabilities in specific scenarios, it struggles to adapt to the complexities of enterprise-level projects. AI is not a "silver bullet" for software development; it must be integrated with software engineering to establish a reliable AI R&D process that combines capability expansion with behavior monitoring, ensuring controllable, predictable, and efficient software delivery quality.  
Photo: Huang Ning, Product R&D Lead at aiXcoder  
Challenges and Reflections on AI Development Models in Enterprise Application Scenarios  
With the advancement of large models, the Vibe Coding development model—which involves "using natural language instructions to have AI generate code that adheres to specific styles"—is gaining traction. Its core feature is delegating nearly all code details to AI generation, with humans focusing only on requirement descriptions and final outcomes.  
However, through engineering practices and interactions with enterprises, aiXcoder has found that directly applying the Vibe Coding model to enterprise-level projects exposes numerous issues: AI-generated code often overlooks existing enterprise tool functions, arbitrarily adds independent modules, and chases...
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Huang Ning, responsable de desarrollo de producto de Silicon Heart Technology (aiXcoder), fue invitado a asistir a la "Conferencia Global de Tecnología de C++ y Software de Sistemas", organizada conjuntamente por CSDN y el Instituto de Investigación de Inteligencia Singular, donde pronunció un discurso titulado "Más allá del Vibe Coding: Construyendo un flujo de desarrollo confiable centrado en las personas". Allí, junto con expertos de empresas como Tencent, Alibaba y Baidu, debatió sobre el estado actual y el futuro del desarrollo de software impulsado por grandes modelos. Huang Ning considera que, aunque el modo Vibe Coding demuestra una alta capacidad de generación en escenarios específicos, resulta difícil adaptarlo al desarrollo de proyectos complejos a nivel empresarial. items.title: Fill PDFs with API, AI creates optimal layouts
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, I’m Carlos, dev & designer behind Hundred Docs. Here’s the deal: I’ve spent way too many days fighting PDFs in production. Two things drove me crazy: 1. Most doc tools give total freedom → anyone can make a layout disaster + UX is terrible. 2. PDF libraries are a nightmare to integrate So I hacked something that actually works: - You describe the doc in plain English - AI turns it into an editable template - Non-tech folks can tweak it visually - Devs just POST JSON to an API → get a professional PDF back Would love to hear what you think about the product idea and your experience with PDF generation in software products.

items.title: 对话黑芝麻CMO杨宇欣：机器人平台发布前已创收，是自然过渡而非跨界
items.raw_excerpt: “比较幸运的是，我们坚持了最开始相信的事。” 在被问及黑芝麻智能如何在机器人赛道守住先发优势时，黑芝麻智能 CMO 杨宇欣语气笃定。 日前，黑芝麻智能于其机器人平台产品发布会上正式官宣布局机器人业务，推出业界首个机器人商业化专属部署平台——SesameX™多维具身智能计算平台，包含Kalos（视觉驱动）、Aura（感控协同）、Liora（认知进化）三大核心模块，已应用于物流车、四足机器人等场景。 对于此次机器人平台的布局，杨宇欣明确表示，这并非跨界之举，而是业务的自然延伸。据雷峰网了解，黑芝麻智能的机器人业务在2024年底启动，截至目前已有多个项目成功落地。该业务在公司整体营收中占比仍较低，尚处于战略布局阶段，但却是其从智能汽车计算芯片向全域智能计算平台拓展的关键里程碑。 黑芝麻智能坚定扮演 “赋能者” 角色，它并未选择亲自下场造机器人，短期内也无专为机器人研发芯片的计划，而是立足芯片主业，最大限度复用智驾领域的技术与生产经验，在工具链、IO 等维度适配现阶段机器人客户的场景需求。 从商业落地来看，黑芝麻智能为机器人业务线锚定了 “卡位 + 布局” 的核心定位。“卡位” 是指在未来机器人产业链中明确自身技术边界，“布局” 则是提前锁定潜在优质客户、理顺上下游产业关系。 从智驾芯片龙头向机器人算力平台拓展，黑芝麻智能试图卡位机器人赛道，成为 AI 时代的端侧 AI 计算平台供应商。 以下为黑芝麻CMO杨宇欣、机器人业务线负责人徐劲与雷峰网等媒体的对话内容，雷峰网作了不改变原意的编辑： Q：机器人平台发布之后，商业化进程大概是怎样的？大概多久能够在推进过程中看到一些收益体现？ 杨宇欣：实际上，黑芝麻的机器人业务早在 2024 年底就启动布局，之所以现在才发布相关平台，是因为目前机器人市场仍处在非常早期的阶段，很难说我们已经摸清了市场的边界。 但从业务落地的角度来看，黑芝麻机器人

excerpt_i18n.en: Fortunately, we have persisted in what we initially believed in. When asked how Black Sesame Technologies maintains its first-mover advantage in the robotics field, CMO Yang Yuxin spoke with conviction. Recently, Black Sesame Technologies officially announced its entry into the robotics business at its robotics platform product launch, unveiling the industry's first dedicated commercial deployment platform for robotics—the SesameX™ Multi-Dimensional Embodied Intelligence Computing Platform. It includes three core modules: Kalos (vision-driven), Aura (sensory-control synergy), and Liora (cognitive evolution), which have already been applied in scenarios such as logistics vehicles and quadruped robots. Regarding this robotics platform initiative, Yang Yuxin clearly stated that it is not a cross-industry move but a natural extension of the business. According to Leiphone, Black Sesame Technologies' robotics business began in late 2024, and several projects have already been successfully implemented to date. This business still accounts for a relatively low proportion of the company's overall revenue and remains in the strategic layout phase, but it marks a key milestone in its expansion from intelligent automotive computing chips to a comprehensive intelligent computing platform. Black Sesame Technologies firmly plays the role of an "enabler." It has not chosen to manufacture robots itself and has no plans to develop chips specifically for robotics in the short term. Instead, it focuses on its core chip business, maximizing the reuse of technology and production experience from the intelligent driving field, and adapting to the current scenario needs of robotics customers in dimensions such as toolchains and I/O. From a commercial implementation perspective, Black Sesame Technologies has anchored its robotics business line with the core positioning of "securing a foothold + strategic layout." "Securing a foothold" refers to positioning in the future robotics
excerpt_i18n.es: Afortunadamente, hemos mantenido nuestra creencia inicial. Al ser preguntado sobre cómo Black Sesame Intelligent mantiene su ventaja pionera en el campo de la robótica, Yang Yuxin, CMO de la empresa, respondió con firmeza. Recientemente, Black Sesame Intelligent anunció oficialmente su incursión en el negocio de la robótica durante el lanzamiento de su plataforma de productos robóticos, presentando la primera plataforma de implementación comercial exclusiva para robótica del sector: la Plataforma de Computación de Inteligencia Corporal Multidimensional SesameX™. Esta incluye tres módulos principales: Kalos (impulsado por visión), Aura (coordinación sensorial y de control) y Liora (evolución cognitiva), ya aplicados en escenarios como vehículos logísticos y robots cuadrúpedos. Respecto a este despliegue de la plataforma robótica, Yang Yuxin expresó claramente.
